reviews.x: LOVE this product. Works quickly and it doesn't pull out my eyelashes like the normal curlers. Just make sure after putting in new batteries that you don't hold it on your lashes for too long or put it too close to your eyelid. It works very well!

Love this product! I curl my lashes for about 15 seconds and it holds the curl all day. I have been using the curler for about two months and have had no issues with eyelash damage at all. Never going back to a traditional eye lash curler.

reviews.t: Beware - You get what you pay for
reviews.x: I hate leaving negative reviews, however, for me this purchase was a bad choice. I'm giving it a 1 rating only because considering where it was coming from the shipment was received in a timely manner. At the beginning I  wasn't expecting this item to last more than 6 months. I wanted to see if the "Heated" curler would actually work for me and then I would purchase a more expensive one. When I opened the back to install batteries the whole insides fell out. At that point I threw it away...not e

If you already curl your lashes then why not with a heated one?? It's the best... if you are looking for a curled lash that lasts,look no further.Its not too hot around eye area either. Its super easy to use...don't be afraid. For the $$ its definitely worth a shot.

I was hesitant to buy this because I was unfamiliar with the brand name. After scanning reviews, I gave in and bought one. It's great! I get a much better, longer lasting curl than with my manual eyelash curler. I've found 8 seconds to be the perfect time to h OP ld it in place before releasing my lashes. I hope this helps. Yes, I'd buy it again, just btw.

This product has rough, unfinished edges where the plastic was not trimmed out of the mold. The plastic parts did not sit flush together as the button was held depressed into the body of the curler. You can clearly see the heating element in the silicon, which was set at an angle in the unit in a clearly dysfunctional way. I had an Avon one of these that lasted years when I was a teenager and thought that since this was the exact same style I was lucky. Yeah, not trusting this thing even without

I had one of these before and it worked very well but broke after 8 months. I ordered another one and am pretty disappointed with it. It does curl my lashes better than a standard eye lash curler but it barely gets warm. The one I had before got a lot hotter, almost too hot, but this one you can hardly feel the heat.
I was hesitant to purchase this item, because it was so cheap. It works perfectly. I don't know how it will work in the long run.....so left a star out.

This product worked awesome!!! I bought something previous for way more money and it broke in 2 weeks.  Would def recommend.  Takes a little getting used to maneuvering lashes into the slot but gets better everyday with practice.
I was skeptical because it looks so cheap, but it actually works!
It heats up but not hot enough to curl the lashes.

reviews.t: Invest in a better quality product
reviews.x: Bought two. One is in good working condition and in good use. The curl last a couple days for me and i love the idea of the product. Bought this cheaper version to see if i want to invest in another brand. Unfortunately there seems to be no quality control, one in good shape but the second is all warped. The part thats supposed to be on the lashes the "cushion" is warped and crooked and can cut some eyelashes off, as there is also no top cushion (ive seen others dont either). On both it does cha
I bough one from a phillyps for around $25 and this is muchhhh better!!! and I have a lot manuals curler and no-one like this `I will definitely recoment it .
Worked great the first time. But it never worked again after. The price where you turn it on broke I’ve literally used it once and that was all.
Arrived cracked and heating element barely curls
30 seconds a day gives me glam level lashes.

reviews.t: The manual On/Off switch makes me crazy...
reviews.x: This little guy does its  job, the only issue I have is it has a switch to turn it on & off with. Every other heated eyelash curler I’ve had in the past automatically turns on when you slide the button forward to curl your lashes & turns off as soon as you slide it to release your lashes.   I have burnt through 3 sets of batteries because I forget to turn it off all of the time.  I finally learned that I can use my blow dryer on the low setting to warm the curling pads instead. Don’t use anythin

reviews.t: Loved it at first but a month is too short, even if it was cheap.
reviews.x: Loved it at first. The curl was beautiful. A little bit awkward to push up the curl button but, it got easier after a few times. It was warm, but never felt uncomfortable, even when I accidentally touched me eye lid with it before clamping down. However, after a couple months and brand new batteries, it wont get warm enough to curl. Wish it would have lasted longer. I would have even paid more for one that lasted longer than a month. Happy then sad way too soon. 😟

reviews.t: Very Cheap but Very nice lift in your lashes!
reviews.x: I was worried this would be a flip, but it works and lasts all day! Just don’t drop it! The plastic is a bit thin and feels like it could crumble!  The packaging had a few typos, but easy to understand directions.  Definitely better alternatives to lash extensions! The design is made for self use only, I tried to use it on my daughter but it was difficult to use on her due to angle of the switch placement

reviews.t: You get what you pay for
reviews.x: This product works, It took a little time to get the hang of it. I did burn my eyelid in the beginning but I think I was holding it wrong??? I'm giving it a 3 star rating because it actually works BUT it's pretty busted looking. The plastic looks unfinished/rough, It looks crooked too. The way it looks definitely reflects the price. I got this for $6.99. You get what you pay for...

reviews.t: Not worth the packaging it's in.
reviews.x: This didn't really do anything the way I'd hoped it would. The width is waaaay to small for an adult's eyes, and the heat isn't warm enough to produce any type of curl. It took over two months to get to me (not Amazon's fault) and not worth the cost it would take to return it. This is a big dud and I suggest you save your money and get something else.

I had purchased a similar one of these eyelash warmers from a .99 cent store that worked great. After a yr of daily use I accidentally broke it. I couldn’t find another one at the stores and turned to amazon. When I use the product it does not heat enough to curl my lashes. Definitely would not purchase again from this seller.

I only just got it but have used it a few times and it curls really well. Heats up fast too and doesn't get crazy hot or anything. I tried a couple of those other heated eyelash curlers, the ones that look like mascara wands, and they didn't really work for me at all. This one so far works great! Hope it lasts!

I was so excited for this after my old tried and true electric eyelash curler died. It was flimsy, but worked the first couple of times. The third time when I pressed up the bottom moving presser part went beyond the top pad and the unit split. Now it won't stop at the top and comes apart. Had to throw it out.

reviews.t: Curls lashes great, but thinks it’s disposable!
reviews.x: This little thing is so worth it - when it works. I’ve probably gone thru 10-12 in the past couple of years. They do not last long at all. But I have tried every lash curler out there and this is the only one that actually curl the lashes and the curl lasts all day. It just quits working after maybe 6 weeks.

claims.text: Many reviewers say it works well and gives a long-lasting curl, often better than a manual curler.
Several reviewers report quality and durability problems, including breakage, cracked units, and rough edges.
Some reviewers say it does not get hot enough to curl lashes effectively.
Reviewers find it easy to use and worth the low price, though some were initially skeptical.
Some reviewers note it does not damage eyelashes and is not too hot around the eye area.
